title: Mexican Chocolate Avocado Mousse
hook: Holiday dessert with no cream and no refined sugar: chocolate avocado mousse, 10 minutes, and nobody guesses the secret
benefit: Fiber and healthy fats from the avocado, antioxidants from the cocoa, no refined sugar
ingredients: 1/4 cup pure maple syrup, plus more to taste
1/4 cup unsweetened almond milk (or any milk)
1/8 tsp cayenne or ancho chili powder (optional)
steps: Halve and pit the avocados and scoop the flesh into a food processor or a strong blender.

Add the cocoa powder, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla, cinnamon, cayenne if using and the salt. Blend 1 to 2 minutes, scraping down the sides, until completely smooth and glossy with no green streaks.
Taste. Add another tablespoon of maple syrup for a sweeter mousse, or a splash more milk if it is too thick to spoon.
Divide among 4 small glasses or ramekins, cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. It keeps covered in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Just before serving, top each glass with raspberries, toasted almonds and a few chocolate shavings.
vo_steps: Scoop two ripe avocados into a food processor.
Add cocoa, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla, cinnamon, a pinch of cayenne and salt. Blend until silky, with no green streaks.
Taste it. More maple for sweeter, a splash of milk if it is too thick.
Spoon into four glasses and chill thirty minutes. It keeps three days.
Top with raspberries, toasted almonds and chocolate shavings, then serve.
